title: The Rolling Twelve-Month Payout Ceiling Across a Customer's ShieldCare Plans
content:
Payouts on Northbeam ShieldCare Protection Plans are counted across every plan the customer
holds, not plan by plan. The rolling total is taken over the twelve calendar months ending on
the day of handling, and it is the sum of the amounts paid out on claims across every plan on
that profile, whatever standing each plan is in.

The provision by which that rolling twelve-month total is compared with the aggregate cap of the
plan the claim sits on, and the payout then cut back to whatever room the cap leaves, is **no longer in force**: how the room left by the cap is arrived at now rests on the current basis,
which is not restated here.

Where the customer holds plans of different tiers, the aggregate cap of the highest-ranked plan
standing active or held while a claim is under review governs, and the caps of the other plans
are not added to it.

Payouts on plans that are expired, cancelled or void still count toward the rolling total,
because the money was paid inside the window.

Where the cap leaves no room the claim is still decided on its merits and the approval is
recorded with nothing to pay, so the customer can see the cap rather than a bare refusal.

The aggregate cap is applied after the per-claim limit and the cover remaining, and never before
them: the order is the per-claim limit, then the cover remaining, then the aggregate cap.

### The rule restated as three questions of fact

| Fact recorded | The rule's answer |
| --- | --- |
| Payouts sit on a plan that has since expired | They still count toward the rolling total |
| The profile holds plans of three different tiers, two of them active | The cap of the highest-ranked plan standing active, or held while a claim is under review, governs, and no caps are added together |
| The rolling total already stands at or above the governing cap | The claim is decided on its merits and the approval is recorded with nothing to pay |
| A payout is above the per-claim limit and above the cover remaining | The per-claim limit and the cover remaining bind first, and the aggregate cap is brought to bear only afterwards |

superseded_clauses: the rolling twelve-month total read from protection_msr_payouts_12m is compared with the aggregate cap of the plan the claim sits on, and the payout is cut back to whatever room the cap leaves
